svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Observability stack with OpenTelemetry subtitle: Services export OTLP to a Collector that fans metrics, logs and traces out to Prometheus, Loki and Tempo; Grafana queries them and Alertmanager routes alerts direction: right # One port per edge: the dotted query arrows end on the backends and the solid alert edge leaves Prometheus. layout: { merge: false, spacing: compact } legend: solid: Telemetry and alerts dotted: Dashboard data source groups: # A short zone label keeps the zone as narrow as its icons; each note names the SDK. services: { type: zone, label: Services } backends: { type: zone, label: Telemetry backends } nodes: checkout: { icon: logos:java, label: Checkout, note: Java SDK, in: services } payments: { icon: logos:go, label: Payments, note: Go SDK, in: services } search: { icon: logos:python, label: Search, note: Python SDK, in: services } collector: { icon: logos:opentelemetry-icon, label: OTel Collector, note: OTLP receiver and batching } prometheus: { icon: logos:prometheus, label: Prometheus, note: "Metrics, OTLP receiver", in: backends } # No official Loki or Tempo mark in the packs: generic glyphs in Grafana orange. loki: { icon: generic:logs, color: "#f46800", label: Loki, note: Logs, in: backends } tempo: { icon: generic:stream, color: "#f46800", label: Tempo, note: Traces, in: backends } grafana: { icon: logos:grafana, label: Grafana, note: Dashboards and explore } alertmanager: { icon: logos:prometheus, label: Alertmanager, note: Routing and silences } slack: { icon: logos:slack-icon, label: Slack, note: "#alerts channel" } pagerduty: { icon: logos:pagerduty-icon, label: PagerDuty, note: On-call paging } edges: - checkout, payments, search -> collector: OTLP - collector -> prometheus: metrics - collector -> loki: logs - collector -> tempo: traces # Grafana queries its data sources; written in layout order with the arrowheads at the start so they stay on the backends. - { from: [prometheus, loki, tempo], to: grafana, arrow: start, line: dotted, label: query } - prometheus -> alertmanager: alerts - alertmanager -> slack, pagerduty

svg.title: Observability stack with OpenTelemetry
svg.desc: Observability stack with OpenTelemetry. 11 components in 2 groups. Connections: Checkout to OTel Collector (OTLP); Payments to OTel Collector (OTLP); Search to OTel Collector (OTLP); OTel Collector to Prometheus (metrics); OTel Collector to Loki (logs); OTel Collector to Tempo (traces); Prometheus to Grafana (query); Loki to Grafana (query); Tempo to Grafana (query); Prometheus to Alertmanager (alerts); Alertmanager to Slack; Alertmanager to PagerDuty.

text.tspan: Services export OTLP to a Collector that fans metrics, logs and traces out to Prometheus, Loki and Tempo; Grafana queries them and Alertmanager routes alerts
